faqs.question: What is 20X and how does it help healthcare staffing agencies?
faqs.answer: 20X is an all-in-one healthcare staffing and nurse scheduling software that helps agencies manage recruitment, credentialing, compliance, and shift scheduling. It streamlines every stage — from candidate onboarding to invoicing — helping agencies fill shifts faster, reduce admin, and stay fully compliant with healthcare regulations in the UK, US, and Canada.

faqs.question: How does 20X simplify recruitment, credentialing, and compliance management?
faqs.answer: 20X automates recruitment and credential verification by storing and tracking staff documents digitally. Real-time alerts notify teams about expiring credentials or missing training, ensuring full compliance. The system links recruitment, compliance, and scheduling, helping agencies maintain audit readiness and eliminate manual spreadsheets or fragmented systems.

faqs.question: Is 20X suitable for nursing agencies, care agencies, and medical staffing companies?
faqs.answer: Yes. 20X is purpose-built for nursing agencies, care agencies, and medical staffing recruitment companies of all sizes. It supports both temporary and permanent staffing workflows, making it ideal for healthcare recruiters, care homes, hospitals, and long-term care facilities that manage staff scheduling and compliance.

faqs.question: What features are included in the 20X healthcare staffing platform?
faqs.answer: 20X includes powerful tools for recruitment, credentialing, compliance, shift scheduling, e-timesheets, invoicing, and payroll exports. It also features a Worker App for nurses and carers to view and accept shifts, submit timesheets, and stay compliant. Each feature is designed to reduce admin workload and improve staffing efficiency.

faqs.question: Does 20X integrate with payroll, accounting, or HR systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. 20X supports exports and integrations for popular payroll, HR, and accounting software. This ensures accurate data transfer, faster invoicing, and smooth payroll processing, eliminating double entry and manual reconciliation.

faqs.question: Can healthcare staff use a mobile app with 20X?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The 20X Worker App allows nurses and healthcare staff to view and accept shifts, upload credentials, complete e-timesheets, and track compliance — all from their phone. It keeps staff connected to their agency in real time and helps fill shifts faster.

faqs.question: How does 20X support credentialing and healthcare compliance requirements?
faqs.answer: 20X automatically tracks licenses, training, and eligibility documents with expiry reminders and compliance dashboards. Agencies can easily manage healthcare credentialing for nurses and carers, reducing the risk of non-compliance and ensuring only qualified staff are placed into shifts.

faqs.question: Does 20X help agencies stay audit-ready and manage expiring documents?
faqs.answer: Yes. 20X provides real-time compliance alerts, document expiry tracking, and digital audit trails. All credentials and training certificates are stored securely in the cloud, giving agencies instant access during audits or inspections — ensuring they remain 100% audit-ready.

faqs.question: How quickly can my agency get started with 20X?
faqs.answer: Most agencies can be fully onboarded in just a few days. Our implementation team assists with setup, data import, and training. Because 20X is cloud-based and easy to use, teams can begin managing shifts, compliance, and payroll almost immediately.

faqs.question: What pricing plans are available for healthcare staffing agencies?
faqs.answer: 20X offers flexible pricing based on your agency size and usage. Plans include access to all core features — recruitment, credentialing, compliance, scheduling, invoicing, and the Worker App. To get a tailored quote, contact our sales team or book a free demo.
